beats.headline: On the door of the Desperado Club
beats.text: Subject is a Crocodilian, an intelligent, thick-skinned, semi-aquatic people who are not celebrated for their quickness, and she works the door of the club. This is a non-combatant posting, which describes her contract rather than her capabilities. Nobody has yet found the argument that gets past her.

beats.headline: Scores to settle
beats.text: Subject, on the door, is told why Crawler Carl arrives without his manager. Her assessment: that'll do it, and he only gets one warning. The manager has spent many hours in this club crying into his cup and has named a list of scores he means to settle once he is out, and the Chaco idiot has come up more than once. She also sells the pair private security, 500 gold for two, because both are on the bounty list. Crawler Donut tries for a better price. Her charm does not work on the subject.

beats.headline: Hunters stuck behind the door
beats.text: The crocodilian bouncer confirms the damage to management's arrangements. Since the hunters were stranded inside by the attack on Zockau, crawlers enter on the top floor and hunters may not come up. The entrance bar cannot be rebuilt without the approval of Zockau's mayor, the mantis whose crotch Carl set alight, and the mantises are keeping the hunters in. Seven have died. Then Princess Donut produces a ledger, and Clarabelle remembers a latch inside a toilet tank in the last stall of the women's bathroom.

beats.headline: Nope
beats.text: Subject sees Crawler Carl's party of thirty walk into the Hairpin, raises both hands, and says: nope. She makes no attempt to stop them. She confirms the door now runs to the top level, then realises that the dachshund is Carl and bursts out laughing. She notes, for the record, that some of the party are permanently banned and some have no pass, and that it would be strangely adorable if half the club did not die every time they came in.
